evidence: Reviewed staged diff in app/build.gradle.kts defaultConfig: versionCode 47 to 48 and versionName 0.3.32 to 0.3.33 (standard tier, configuration-only change per review rules) plus .gentle-review artifact updates

aapt dump badging on app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk reports package com.example.projectacc versionCode 48 versionName 0.3.33, confirming the bump matches the built artifact (build-tools 36.0.0)

findings.location: app/build.gradle.kts:18-19 versionCode and versionName maintained manually
findings.claim: versionCode and versionName are bumped by hand on every release with no central release config or automation; forgetting versionCode while bumping versionName would silently keep the old code and block package updates or cause downgrade installs to fail. The current chore-release convention plus aapt verification mitigates but does not remove the regression risk.
